dialogue.speaker: orange
dialogue.text: Maybe you should take fewer hours at work, then. That way, you can take care of our home a little more, and I can focus on taking care of the bills.

dialogue.speaker: purple
dialogue.text: But… I need the money from my shifts.

dialogue.speaker: orange
dialogue.text: For what? I'll cover all our expenses anyway. And honestly, I'd feel so much better knowing you're not exhausting yourself all the time.
